Name: Content Patcher - Glass Bottle Mailbox
Author: seasIug
Description:
Turns the mailbox into a glass bottle, with seasonal textures! Works with any farm type.

The mod will detect if you use vanilla, or have [url=https://cafe.naver.com/starvall/317772]OnOff's Map Pastel Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10635] Blue Grass Recolor[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6367] Vibrant Pastoral Recolor[/url], or [url=https://www.moddrop.com/stardew-valley/mods/580620-eemies-just-a-new-map-recolour-content-patcher-edition] Eemie's Map Recolor[/url], DaisyNiko's Earthy Recolour, and use the bottle colors created for your recolor. Feel free to ask for more recolor compatibility! It's compatible with Ganyo and Esji's Terrain by Ttoleuleuleumwaseu, but because these mods are distributed for merging, you have to select the recolor choice manually. You can manually choose which recolor the bottles use with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url].

"Sand" and "Message" are optional decorative features. Sand adds a sandy texture to the floor, like a supply crate. "Message" adds a small note to the bottle, it is cosmetic and doesn't mean there is mail.

[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/19807]Available for Alternative Textures[/url]!
